A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a survey and benchmark of single-image methods that can be used for quantitative evaluation of dehazing methods.
the benchmark shows a clear gap in the existing single-image dehazing methods and the performance of the best methods are still significantly far from the performance of the methods with known depth.
we provide the first comprehensive survey for the problem of image enhancement from hazy or fogged scenes, and we provide a quantitative comparison of the existing methods.

the performance of existing methods varies greatly and that no existing method is able to consistently outperform the others.
